title: Ionworks collaborates with Sila Nanotechnologies
summary: Ionworks is collaborating with Sila Nanotechnologies to integrate physics-based battery simulation directly into advanced silicon-carbon material development, providing battery engineers with predictive, serializable cell models.
body_markdown:
We're excited to share that Ionworks is collaborating with[Sila Nanotechnologies, Inc.](https://www.silanano.com/) to integrate physics-based battery simulation directly into advanced silicon-carbon material development, providing battery engineers with predictive, serializable cell models.


By pairing Ionworks' simulation engine with Sila's rich experimental testing data, engineering teams can virtually screen custom blend ratios, project mechanical swelling, and transfer plating-aware fast-charge protocols across chemistries without exhaustive bench matrices.


Stay tuned in the coming weeks for a series of deep-dive case studies and application notes breaking down how this joint workflow operates in practice. If you're looking to replace lengthy trial-and-error build cycles with native modeling workflows, we'd love to connect.
